pull_request.title: EXP-15: controlled MVP experiment for bounded project memory layer

problem: Repeated context rediscovery across MPE sessions required repository/document searches to recover prior decisions and constraints.
meaningful_changes: Added an experiment-only, file-backed project-memory prototype and its bounded memory model.
Added a deterministic acceptance harness for RECALL, UPDATE, DELETE, ISOLATION, PROVENANCE, and FAILURE behavior.
Added frozen benchmark fixtures and a Mode A baseline versus Mode B memory-layer evaluator with recorded evidence.
Kept Git as the sole source of truth; memory writes remain approval-gated, with no production code or persistent service added.
remaining_limitation: This is a controlled four-task experiment, not production validation or proof of broad generalization; no production integration or persistent service was introduced.
